console-help.statement: The Troubleshooting Private Cloud Controllers article provides debugging commands in the Private Cloud Controller console, run from /opt/zscaler/var/pcc/image/bin at a pcc> prompt whose help lists show, check, run-all or tech-support (execute all important commands in one shot), help, usage, version and exit or quit.

quotes: This article provides debugging commands in the Private Cloud Controller console to help with troubleshooting.
cd /opt/zscaler/var/pcc/image/bin

pcc> help Suggestions: show show command check perform check run-all | tech-support execute all important commands in one shot help | ? print this help usage print usage version print version exit | quit exit the program

show-commands.statement: The show commands cover journal logs from the last 1 hours, status of a specified object, statistics, connections, current configuration and backups.

quotes: logs show journal logs from last 1 hours status show status of specified object statistics | stats show statistics connection show connections config show current configuration backups show backups

To show the status of Business Continuity, enter the following command:

restore.statement: Restoring configuration settings from a Private Cloud Controller backup overwrites all the controller's current configurations. The restore runs zpa-pcc-restore.py restore <label>, where the label is the prefix of the snapshot in the zpa-pcc-restore.py show command (for example 2025-09-30) as long as it uniquely identifies the snapshot; otherwise an error appears and more information must be added. The help's example output shows the backup directory /opt/zscaler/backup/pcc_backup and that the zpa-pcc service will be stopped before restore.

quotes: When you restore configuration settings from a Private Cloud Controller backup, it overwrites all your current configurations for the Private Cloud Controller.
[admin@pcc ~]$ sudo /opt/zscaler/var/pcc/image/bin/zpa-pcc-restore.py restore <label>
The <label> is the prefix of the snapshot in the zpa-pcc-restore.py show command (e.g., 2025-09-30, 2025-09-30-00-00) as long it can be uniquely identified as the snapshot
If the label isn't unique enough to determine which snapshot to use, an error similar to the following appears when you try to restore, and you must add more information to make it unique:
Set backup directory as "/opt/zscaler/backup/pcc_backup"

bc-mode-output.title: What show status bcp prints in Business Continuity mode
bc-mode-output.detail: The page's show status bcp example shows only Running in Normal Mode (Non-BC Mode); the output while in Business Continuity mode is not shown.

restore-restart.title: Whether the zpa-pcc service restarts after a restore
restore-restart.detail: The restore example shows the zpa-pcc service being stopped before restore, but the captured page does not show whether it is started again.
